jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior EM / Director of Engineering - Marketplace

Onsite - San Francisco, CA

Base $250k - $350k + Equity

FutureTech Recruitment is partnered with a $65M funded Series B marketplace startup backed by Scale Ventures and top-tier institutional investors. They are building infrastructure for one of the largest and most fragmented markets in the world – 8x-ed revenue last year, engineering team tripling this year, and customers including some of the most recognisable names in tech.

They’re now hiring a Senior EM or Director of Engineering to own the Marketplace team - the allocation, matching, and distribution systems that sit at the core of the business. This is a player-coach role with real ownership: incentives, payments, pricing mechanics, A/B testing, and the algorithms that balance supply and demand at scale. Your work directly dictates how the marketplace performs.

Responsibilities

Own core marketplace health - allocation, matching, and distribution systems that balance supply and demand
Work closely with product and data science to design and implement incentives, payments, and pricing mechanics
Drive a culture of experimentation - A/B testing, guardrail metrics, and data-driven decisions
Hire, coach, and level a pod of senior-leaning engineers, fostering high judgment and autonomy
Lead roadmap and delivery - translating ambiguous business goals into clear, actionable quarterly plans
Operate as a player-coach - system design, code reviews, incident debugging, and occasionally shipping code

Requirements

Senior EM: 2+ years managing teams of 7-8+ engineers. Director: 5+ years managing 15+ people
Strong background in marketplace, payments, or pricing systems
Recent hands-on experience - code reviews, debugging incidents, system design
Data-fluent: writes own SQL, analyses A/B tests, validates experiment results
Experience hiring and developing senior-leaning software engineers
AI fluency - uses AI for docs, research, code review, or internal tooling

$65M raised, Scale-backed, hypergrowth trajectory, and engineering team tripling this year. If you’re a marketplace-native engineering leader who wants to own systems where code and economics collide, click Apply Now!
